articles.summary: Supporting the health, well-being, and long-term development of communities where it operates, Gildan recently launched a two-year partnership with Sightsavers Bangladesh to help improve access to quality eye care for employees and nearby communities. As part of the partnership, the Company will help fund vision diagnoses and treatments, including eye screenings, cataract surgeries, treatment for refractive errors, and provision of glasses and medicines. In addition to offering essential eye care services, the project comprises an educational component. A dedicated school eye health program will equip teachers and students alike to perform basic eye tests on peers. Gildan employees will also be trained for the same, ensuring that eye care remains accessible to as many people as possible.
articles.title: Gildan Improves Community Access to Eye Care in Bangladesh in Collaboration with Sightsavers
